text:
Alyssa: dropping a quick thread after today's sync — exploring two variants for the catalog toolbar: compact (dense rows, inline filters) vs spacious (separate filter rail). also want takes on how version pinning is surfaced in list rows. figma: https://figma.redwood/mock/catalog-v2

Diego: compact is nice for power users, but discoverability for filter categories suffers. can we show a collapsed rail with an accordion? default to compact for >=1200px width, rail for smaller widths.

Sam: pinning: users expect a clear affordance. inline "snapshot" label reads passive. what if we show a subtle pin icon to the right of the model name + hover text "Pinned version" and a timestamp under name in small type? clicking pin opens version history flyout.

Renee: accessibility nits: 1) filter chips need focus-visible styles (not just outline). 2) when we move pills left of the name, ensure text read order for screen readers is still: name, version, metric. use visually-hidden spans for separators.

Alyssa: good call. also we need copy for the snapshot affordance. current placeholder uses "snapshot" which confused PMs. suggestions?

Diego: "Pinned version" or "Pinned snapshot" are explicit. if default is latest, show "Latest (default)" when not pinned.

Sam: on performance badges: prefer numeric + icon instead of color-only. show "P99 120ms" with a filled dot that changes color. that helps color-blind users and meets WCAG when combined with text.

Renee: confirm contrast: we measured current badge at 3.1:1. need 4.5:1 for regular text; if badge uses small text, 7:1 ideally. consider reverse (dark text on light bg) or outline + bold number.

Alyssa: UX trade: compact vs spacious also affects compare flow. if rows are denser, multi-select becomes fiddly. proposal: keep sticky left column with the compare checkboxes and expose a floating compare CTA when at least 2 selected. CTA should be reachable via keyboard (tab order after selection).

Diego: Agree. Also, add an unobtrusive counter near top-left: "2 selected" that doubles as the compare CTA on click. keyboard users can press Enter on that counter.

UX-bot: Reminder: product a11y checklist requires visible focus states, explicit ARIA labels for non-text icons, and touch target minimum of 44px for interactive elements.

Sam: version pin interactions: keyboard flow idea: focus on version area -> press Space/Enter to toggle pin flyout -> arrow keys navigate versions -> Enter selects pin -> Esc closes. add an "Unpin" action in the flyout.

Renee: Also test with screen reader: announce "Model X, version v3.4, P99 120ms, pinned". For non-pinned: "Model X, latest version v3.6, P99 95ms". Ensure aria-live region updates when pin state changes.

Alyssa: copy proposals for badges and chips: badge: "P99 120ms"; status dot alt: "good/moderate/poor"; search placeholder: "Search models, tasks, tags... (press /)"; filter chip clear tooltip: "Remove filter".

Diego: tiny polish: when a filter is selected, show count badge next to filter category (e.g., "Task (3)") so people know how many active filters.

Sam: logging: please add an event for pin/unpin and compare-open with metadata so we can A/B test default view density. design-infra, can you add tracking keys?

design-infra: noted. adding events: catalog.pin, catalog.unpin, catalog.compare_open, catalog.density_toggle. will share schema.

Alyssa: ok next steps: I'll iterate mocks with: 1) compact baseline + collapsed rail behavior, 2) badge numeric + dot, 3) pin icon + flyout keyboard flow, 4) sticky compare column + floating CTA. I'll post updated frames by EOD and tag you all for final pass. Thanks! :rocket:
